messages:
maria: Heads up — canary slice 7 is seeing out-of-order responses and p95 jumped to 820ms after today's release.
jamie: noticed that too, looks like traffic skewed to a few hosts. dashboard: https://grafana/repl/abc :eyes:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused automatically: anomaly detection threshold breached for canary slice 7. Suggested actions: manual rollback OR narrow traffic slice.
eng_lead: Can we pin back to v2.9.1 for the canary? What's the blast radius if we rollback only slice 7?
sre_oncall: blast radius small, it's the us-west canary pool. I can run targeted revert for those hosts. Recommend manual rollback to be safe.
alex: command to revert one canary pool: `redwoodctl rollout revert --pool canary-usw --to-version v2.9.1` — I'll prep the runbook now.
maria: collecting logs and traces. uploading short trace here: https://logs/trace/xy123 :mag:
kim: heads up to support and PG — I'll draft a one-paragraph customer note if we roll back.
jamie: if we do manual rollback, also pin dedicated release tags so auto-rollforward doesn't re-trigger.
eng_lead: agree. do the manual revert, pin canary to v2.9.1, keep monitoring for 30m, then decide next steps. @sre_oncall you have the go?
sre_oncall: starting revert now. will post status updates. :arrow_forward:
deploy-bot: Action started: targeted revert initiated by sre_oncall for pool canary-usw -> v2.9.1. ID rb-507000A
sre_oncall: revert completed on 6/6 hosts. traffic rebalanced to v2.9.1. p95 dropping back to 120ms. continuing validation.
maria: logs look cleaner, no new errors. marking incident as mitigated in notes.
eng_lead: nice job. @kim hold the customer note until we confirm 30m stable, then share. alex please follow up with postmortem checklist.
alex: will file postmortem stub and link runbook + alerts. tag me if anything else pops up.
kim: noted, will wait. :white_check_mark:
